record.bible_text: Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> this word<WH01697>, ye kine<WH06510> of Bashan<WH01316>, that <FI>are<Fi> in the mountain<WH02022> of Samaria<WH08111>, which oppress<WH06231><WTH8802> the poor<WH01800>, which crush<WH07533><WTH8802> the needy<WH034>, which say<WH0559><WTH8802> to their masters<WH0113>, Bring<WH0935><WTH8685>, and let us drink<WH08354><WTH8799>.
